 UFC 334 post-fight press conference video
 Ciryl Gane, Kayla Harrison defend UFC titles at UFC 334
 by Bryan Tucker Nov 15, 2026, 6:06 AM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Bryan Tucker is the managing editor-in-chief of MMA Fighting and the executive director of combat sports at SB Nation. He has led MMA Fighting since 2009. The UFC 334 post-fight press conference is the last piece of business to take care of after the action is over in the Octagon, and we have the live video above at MMAFighting.com.
 UFC officials will announce the winners of the “Fight of the Night” and the “Performance of the Night” bonuses, and winning fighters will meet the media after their fights.
 UFC President Dana White will also wrap up the event, discuss star’s performances, and possibly talk about what’s next on the UFC calendar, during his scrum with the media.
 The UFC 334 post-fight press conference takes place about 30 minutes after the main event ends, meaning it will start around 1 a.m. ET.
